presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (2026-09-26, from LAW-0687/0689-0692; docs/AUTHORING.md item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 the free floor of the room beside the right-hand text column cannot hold four near-maximum participant chips (two of them with a statement) AND two near-maximum exhibit tags: with the exhibit tags at 43 and 46 characters one tag (or, in other orders, participant A's chip) has no clear place in any tried composition. Tried before capping (all at 1:1, text 22.5 down to 16.4 px): right-hand text column at 0.25-0.39 of the width; text band under the room in 2 and 3 columns; room scale 1, 1.25 and 1.55 (smaller people, more free floor); exhibit cabinet on the left wall, along the bottom wall and on the right wall; diagonal seats in tall rooms; participant chips first or exhibit tags first (both tag orders); five chip widths per participant and three per tag. Rendered numbers (final code, re-measured 2026-09-27 at the hold with production/scratch/hearings-01/capmeasure.mjs, 1080p-normalised) BEFORE the cap (43/46-character tags): 16:9 19.8 px text / people 82.1 px, 9:16 21.6 px / 80.0 px, 1:1 16.4 px / 84.3 px with participant C's chip unplaced (chip-sp2 flagged, fallback chip). AFTER the cap (36/34-character tags): every chip placed — 16:9 19.8 px / 82.1 px, 9:16 20.7 px / 101.5 px, 1:1 16.4 px / 68.1 px. Only the two exhibit tags are shortened; they stay longer than the baseline tag (21 characters); counts are unchanged (4 participants, 2 statements, 2 exhibits); every other field keeps its near-maximum length. Pre-cap preset kept at production/scratch/hearings-01/LAW-0281.presets.precap.json.
